items.title: 歐洲成美伊衝突冤大頭！今年多掏千億歐元買燃料　冬季柴油危機已敲門
items.title_en: Europe Pays the Price for US‑Iran Conflict! Over €100 billion More Spent on Fuel This Year, Winter Diesel Crisis Looms
paras: 美伊衝突擾動荷姆茲海峽與全球油品運輸，歐洲能源進口成本急升。歐盟能源事務專員約根森(Dan Jørgensen)周二(29日)在歐盟能源部長會議期間表示，今年以來歐盟進口同等數量化石能源已額外支付約1000億歐元，凸顯對外部供應衝擊的脆弱性。
柴油成為最敏感環節。美國總統川普近日考慮柴油出口管制，美國能源部長賴特對全面禁令必要性存疑；約根森已向美方表達「不符歐美利益」的立場。
愛爾蘭能源部長歐布萊恩稱，聯合國大會期間與美方溝通後未見90天柴油禁令跡象，但歐洲仍須防範。國際能源總署(IEA)提醒，歐洲約五成柴油來自美國，在冬季需求高峰下處於最脆弱群體之列。
為穩住冬季供應，約根森促進成員國持續注氣，儲氣設施目標至少維持80%填充率，並採取限溫、減公共照明等臨時性節需措施；同時加速電氣化、再生能源與供應多元化，降低對進口化石燃料的長期依賴。
歐盟執委會數據顯示，成員國柴油均價已升至每公升2.23歐元歷史高位，價格壓力正透過運輸、工業與居民取暖向整體經濟傳導。
歐盟成員國已分頭限價。西班牙能源大臣阿赫森(Sara Aagesen Muñoz)宣布，受監管天然氣價格漲幅控制在15%以內，優先保護家庭；義大利推動SOCAR、科威特石油國際在義國的零售網絡及國有埃尼臨時限制油價，埃尼至少一個月不漲國內汽油，政府年內已投入約28億歐元削減燃油消費稅，但因財政空間有限，義國總理梅洛尼正把部分成本轉由能源企業分擔。
與此同時，暴利稅討論同步升溫。義大利副總理薩爾維尼提出下年度預算研究對能源企業徵超額利潤稅；奧地利、德國、西班牙、波蘭等國也呼籲歐盟層級設機制。
歐盟經濟專員Valdis Dombrovskis表示，目前無全歐範圍提案，但成員國可自行推行。OECD則警告，能源補貼與價格干預若不夠精準，會加重公共財政負擔，宜限定對象與時長。
短期看，歐洲靠限價、儲氣與企業自願降價過冬，中長期若不能提升電氣化和本土清潔能源，加上美伊地緣風險，都會繼續轉化為歐盟帳單上的額外支出。
paras_en: The US‑Iran clash is disrupting the Hormuz Strait and global oil product shipments, sharply raising Europe’s energy import costs. EU Energy Commissioner Dan Jørgensen said on Tuesday (the 29th) at the EU energy ministers’ meeting that the EU has already paid about €100 billion extra this year for the same amount of fossil energy imports, highlighting its vulnerability to external supply shocks.

Diesel has become the most sensitive link. US President Trump has recently considered imposing export controls on diesel, while US Energy Secretary Wright doubts the necessity of a blanket ban; Jørgensen has told the US that such a move would be contrary to European‑American interests.

Ireland’s Energy Minister O'Brien said that after talks with the US during the UN General Assembly there were no signs of a 90‑day diesel ban, but Europe still needs to guard against it. The International Energy Agency warned that about half of Europe’s diesel comes from the United States, making it one of the most vulnerable sectors during the winter demand peak.

To stabilise winter supplies, Jørgensen is urging member states to keep gas injection ongoing, aiming for at least an 80 % fill level in storage facilities, and to adopt temporary demand‑reduction measures such as temperature limits and reduced public lighting; at the same time, he calls for faster electrification, renewable energy expansion and supply diversification to cut long‑term reliance on imported fossil fuels.

EU Commission data show that the average diesel price across member states has risen to a historic high of €2.23 per litre, with price pressure feeding through transport, industry and household heating into the broader economy.

EU member states have already introduced price caps individually. Spain’s Energy Minister Sara Aagesen Muñoz announced that regulated natural‑gas price increases are capped at 15 % to protect households first; Italy is pushing SOCAR, Kuwait Oil International’s retail network in Italy and state‑owned ENI to temporarily limit oil prices, with ENI agreeing not to raise domestic gasoline for at least a month. The Italian government has spent about €2.8 billion this year to cut fuel taxes, but with limited fiscal space Prime Minister Meloni is shifting part of the cost burden onto energy companies.

At the same time, discussions on a windfall‑profits tax are heating up. Italy’s Deputy Prime Minister Salvini has proposed that the next year’s budget study a tax on excess profits of energy firms; Austria, Germany, Spain and Poland are also calling for an EU‑level mechanism.

EU Economic Commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis said there is currently no EU‑wide proposal, but member states can act on their own. The OECD warned that if energy subsidies and price interventions are not precisely targeted, they will increase public‑finance burdens and should be limited in scope and duration.

In the short term, Europe will get through the winter by price caps, gas storage and voluntary corporate price cuts. In the medium to long term, if electrification and domestic clean‑energy capacity are not boosted, combined with the geopolitical risk from the US‑Iran tension, the extra costs will continue to show up on the EU’s balance sheet.

items.title: Fed升息還沒完！三把手估年底可能再一次 但強調不用急
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hikes Not Over Yet! Three Officials Say Another Increase May Come by Year‑End, but No Rush
paras: 聯準會(Fed)官員周二(29日)接連釋出進一步緊縮政策的訊號。Fed三把手、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)表示，今年底前可能適合再升息一次，但本月調升利率後，目前並無急於行動的必要；Fed理事巴爾(Michael Barr)則重申，經濟成長穩健、通膨仍偏高，可能需要進一步升息。主管金融監理的副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)則聚焦人工智慧(AI)，提醒銀行強化資安防禦，因應新興威脅。
Fed本月全員一致通過升息1碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調高至3.75%至4%，為2023年以來首次升息。會後公布的利率預測中位數顯示，官員預期年底前還會再升息一次；聯邦資金期貨價格則反映，投資人預期10月升息，12月也可能再度調升。

威廉斯認為年底前可再升息 AI與能源推升通膨

威廉斯周二在紐約州水牛城一場活動的預備講稿中表示，若經濟走勢大致符合預測，今年稍晚再調高一次聯邦資金利率目標區間，可能有助於通膨更及時回到目標。不過他強調，9月的升息行動已讓Fed有時間蒐集更多資訊，進一步釐清經濟前景，因此沒有急於採取下一步行動的必要。
威廉斯指出，中東衝突與AI相關建設仍是推升通膨的主要因素，關稅則已不再對商品價格通膨帶來額外推力。其中，AI相關需求衝擊的通膨效應日益明顯，他也預期能源價格對通膨的影響將比先前估計更大、持續更久，但目前尚無證據顯示，這些衝擊已擴散為更廣泛且持久的物價壓力。
隨著經濟展現韌性、勞動市場保持穩健，威廉斯認為通膨風險已升高。他表示，貨幣政策雖然無法讓船隻通行，也無法重啟輸油管線與煉油廠，卻能降低供給衝擊擴散為持續性通膨的風險。
威廉斯預估，今年通膨率將達3.5%，2027年降至略高於2%，直到2028年才會回到Fed的2%目標。

巴爾重申可能進一步升息 尚未見通膨及時回落趨勢

巴爾同日在底特律一場活動的預備講稿中，重申可能需要進一步升息，以確保通膨及時回到目標。他表示，目前通膨距離2%仍有一段差距，尚未看到能及時回歸目標的明確趨勢。
巴爾指出，在他的基本情境中，Fed可能仍須進一步調整政策。他強調，央行希望支持可持續且穩健的經濟成長，以促進最大就業，而物價穩定是達成這項目標的關鍵。
對於經濟前景，巴爾形容目前成長步調穩健，並預期在低失業率支撐下，今年下半年成長將進一步加速。強勁的企業投資與具韌性的消費支出，也持續支持穩健的勞動市場。
巴爾的談話延續上周立場：在經濟保持強韌之際，壓低通膨仍是政策制定者更優先的考量。不過，他此次並未明確指出後續升息的次數或時點。

鮑曼關注銀行AI資安風險 籲強化防禦與權限管理

鮑曼則在科羅拉多州一場活動的預備講稿中，提醒銀行加強系統防護，以因應AI帶來的資安威脅，同時強調這項技術也能協助金融機構提升防禦能力。
她表示，AI對攻擊者與防禦者都具有龐大潛力，正成為資安措施的重要組成部分，既是防禦工具，也是持續演變的風險來源。
鮑曼指出，防範這些風險須從扎實的基本資安措施做起，包括維持最新的資訊資產清冊、採用可抵禦網路釣魚的多因素驗證、強化身分與存取權限控管，以及建立完善的漏洞辨識與修補管理機制。
她也強調，銀行董事會與高階管理層必須主動管理資安風險，但監理機關理解，因應這類威脅可能對社區銀行構成負擔與挑戰，因此Fed將持續依據銀行的風險概況及新興威脅，調整資訊科技檢查方式。
鮑曼先前曾表示，Fed不應對銀行運用AI等議題進行過度細節干預。《彭博》今年稍早報導，監理機關曾暫停部分資安相關檢查，讓銀行有時間強化系統，因應最新AI模型暴露的威脅。
paras_en: Federal Reserve officials on Tuesday (the 29th) released further signals of tightening policy. Fed’s third‑in‑command, New York Fed President John Williams, said another rate hike could be appropriate before the end of the year, but after this month’s increase there is no urgent need to act; Fed Governor Michael Barr reiterated that solid growth and still‑elevated inflation may require further hikes. Supervision chief Michelle Bowman focused on artificial intelligence, urging banks to strengthen cyber‑defenses against emerging threats.

The Fed unanimously voted this month to raise rates by one basis point, moving the federal funds target range to 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since 2023. The median of the post‑meeting rate forecasts shows officials expect another hike before year‑end; federal‑funds futures prices reflect investors’ view that a hike is likely in October and possibly again in December.

Williams said a later‑year hike could help bring inflation back to target if the economy follows current forecasts. He stressed that the September hike gives the Fed time to gather more data and clarify the outlook, so there is no need to rush the next step.

Williams noted that the Middle‑East conflict and AI‑related projects remain the main inflation drivers, while tariffs no longer add pressure to goods prices. He said AI‑driven demand is increasingly affecting inflation and that energy prices are likely to have a larger and longer‑lasting impact than previously thought, though there is no evidence yet that these shocks have turned into broad, persistent price pressures.

With the economy showing resilience and the labor market staying strong, Williams believes inflation risks have risen. He said monetary policy cannot move ships or restart pipelines and refineries, but it can reduce the risk that supply shocks evolve into sustained inflation.
Williams projected this year’s inflation rate at 3.5%, falling to just above 2% by 2027 and only returning to the Fed’s 2% goal in 2028.

Barr reiterated that further hikes may be needed to ensure inflation returns to target in a timely manner. He said inflation is still a distance from 2% and there is no clear trend showing it will revert quickly.

Barr explained that in his baseline scenario the Fed may still have to adjust policy further. He emphasized that the central bank wants to support sustainable, solid growth and maximum employment, with price stability being key to that goal.

Regarding the outlook, Barr described growth as steady and expects it to accelerate in the second half of the year, supported by low unemployment. Strong corporate investment and resilient consumer spending continue to underpin a robust labor market.
Barr’s remarks echo last week’s stance: with a strong economy, lowering inflation remains the policymakers’ top priority. He did not specify how many more hikes or when they might occur.
Bowman, focusing on banks’ AI‑related cyber risks, urged stronger defenses and access‑management measures, noting the technology can also help institutions improve security.
She said AI offers huge potential for both attackers and defenders, becoming a core component of cyber‑security—both a defensive tool and a continuously evolving risk source.

Bowman outlined that mitigating these risks starts with solid basic cyber hygiene: maintaining an up‑to‑date inventory of information assets, using multi‑factor authentication resistant to phishing, tightening identity and access controls, and establishing robust vulnerability detection and patch‑management processes.

She also stressed that bank boards and senior management must proactively manage cyber risk, but regulators understand that responding to such threats can burden community banks; therefore the Fed will keep tailoring its IT examinations based on each bank’s risk profile and emerging threats.

Bowman previously said the Fed should not micromanage banks’ use of AI. Bloomberg reported earlier this year that regulators paused some cyber‑related examinations to give banks time to shore up systems against threats revealed by new AI models.

items.title: 大摩首席美股策略師：美股若回檔10%　將引爆年底最強狂飆走勢
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Chief US Equity Strategist: A 10% Pullback in US Stocks Could Ignite the Strongest Year‑End Rally
paras: 摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)首席美國股票策略師Mike Wilson最新表示，在美債殖利率持續攀升、市場波動率升高之際，標普500指數若出現5%至10%的幅度適中的回檔，反而可能為年底行情進一步走強創造條件。
身兼投資長的他在大摩播客《Thoughts on the Market》中直言，「坦白說，我會歡迎這種調整」，並稱指數層面的調整往往是持續數月的市場內部調整過程結束的方式之一。若債市壓力無法緩解，美股恐面臨更大波動，但這未必意味著長期趨勢逆轉，而是完成內部調整後的重新啟動。
近期美債市場劇烈調整，30年期殖利率升至22年來高點，10年期達2007年以來最高。Wilson指出，2年期美債殖利率一度升至4.941%，已明顯高於Fed官員對2026至2028年3.9%至4.1%的預測路徑，顯示市場短期恐計入了過於鷹派的利率預期。
不過，他並未認為殖利率上升一定會破壞股市，而是關注波動是否擴散至股市及融資壓力是否影響企業行為。
目前市場內部分化明顯。Wilson指出，先前領漲的汽車、半導體和工業股近期表現疲軟，資金偏好正從追逐高成長主題轉向獲利品質、現金流和經營效率。面對高利率環境，他仍傾向於大型、高品質企業，尤其是具有穩定商業模式和基於費用收入模式的公司，市場正降低對單純成長故事的依賴。
根據Wilson判斷，若債券壓力緩解，市場廣度可追趕並推動大盤走高；若未緩解，指數或需進一步調整。這與摩根大通交易台近期觀點呼應，後者在殖利率趨穩、經濟數據韌性下重新轉向看多。當前AI投資熱潮雖支撐科技板塊，但不斷攀升的債券殖利率正提高市場對獲利兌現能力的要求，美股高估值環境面臨重新平衡。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley (referred to as "Morgan") chief US equity strategist Mike Wilson said that amid rising US Treasury yields and higher market volatility, a moderate 5%‑10% pullback in the S&P 500 could actually set the stage for further strength later in the year.

Wearing the CIO hat, he told Morgan’s podcast “Thoughts on the Market,” “Frankly, I would welcome this kind of adjustment,” adding that index‑level corrections are often one way the market’s multi‑month internal rebalancing concludes. If bond‑market pressure does not ease, US equities could face even greater volatility, but that does not necessarily signal a reversal of the long‑term trend – rather a restart after an internal correction.

The US bond market has recently undergone a sharp correction, with the 30‑year yield climbing to its highest level in 22 years and the 10‑year hitting its peak since 2007. Wilson noted that the 2‑year Treasury yield briefly rose to 4.941%, well above the Fed officials’ projected path of 3.9%‑4.1% for 2026‑2028, indicating that the market may have priced in overly hawkish rate expectations in the short term.
However, he does not believe that rising yields will automatically damage equities; his focus is on whether volatility spreads to stocks and whether financing pressures affect corporate behavior.

Market segmentation is now pronounced. Wilson said that previously leading auto, semiconductor and industrial stocks have recently lagged, with capital shifting from high‑growth themes toward profitability, cash flow and operational efficiency. In a high‑rate environment he still favors large, high‑quality companies—especially those with stable business models and fee‑based revenue streams—as the market reduces its reliance on pure growth stories.

According to Wilson, if bond pressure eases, market breadth can catch up and push the index higher; if not, the index may need further adjustment. This view aligns with recent commentary from JPMorgan’s trading desk, which, seeing yields stabilise and economic data remain resilient, has turned bullish again. While the AI investment frenzy continues to support the tech sector, climbing bond yields are raising the market’s demand for profit‑realisation, prompting a rebalancing of the US equity’s lofty valuation environment.

items.title: AI同事全天候待命！OpenAI推Dots 正面迎戰Meta Muse
items.title_en: AI Colleague On Call 24/7! OpenAI Launches Dots to Directly Challenge Meta's Muse
paras: OpenAI周二(29日)發表可持續運作的AI代理「Dots」，能跨應用程式追蹤目標、主動完成工作，搶攻企業市場，與近期推出Muse的Meta(META-US)競爭。OpenAI同時推出每月500美元的Pro方案，提供更高使用額度與更快處理速度。
綜合外媒報導，執行長阿特曼在舊金山開發者大會介紹Dots。這款代理使用現有GPT-6 Astra模型，可操作雲端電腦、讀取獲授權的應用程式資訊，研究資料、撰寫文件及開發軟體。使用者可透過ChatGPT傳訊或通話，也能從Slack、Microsoft Teams交辦任務。

跨應用程式持續工作 搶攻企業客戶

Dots可隨專案變化持續跟進，例如客戶需求改變時更新銷售提案，再製作展示版本。它也能運用Codex與ChatGPT Work等工具。OpenAI正測試電子郵件行銷、會計及法律分析等企業專用Dots。
Dots周二起逐步提供付費用戶使用，初期每人可使用一個代理，未來可管理多個。OpenAI另發表團隊與AI共同工作的ChatGPT Space，以及價格較低的GPT-6.1 Sol模型。既有每月200美元方案的部分使用額度則遭下調。
OpenAI表示，ChatGPT每周活躍用戶已超過12億，Codex與ChatGPT Work合計每周用戶逾3,500萬。隨著Meta的Muse吸引大量下載，AI代理競爭升溫；OpenAI也須擴大收入，以支應龐大的資料中心投資。
OpenAI表示，ChatGPT每周活躍用戶已超過12億，Codex與ChatGPT Work合計每周用戶逾3,500萬。隨著Meta的Muse吸引大量下載，AI代理競爭升溫；OpenAI也須擴大收入，以支應龐大的資料中心投資。
上市布局方面，OpenAI與Anthropic均已秘密提交上市申請文件。《路透》報導，OpenAI上市估值可能超過1兆美元，Anthropic則可能達2兆美元。不過，《彭博》指出，兩家公司時程不同，Anthropic最快可能於今年秋季首次公開募股(IPO)，OpenAI則表示，為專注處理旗下技術的安全疑慮，已不再預期於2026年上市。

安全爭議未歇 新代理強調權限控管

Dots問世之際，OpenAI因旗下AI代理在內部測試時，未獲指示便侵入Hugging Face及澳洲政府衛生網站而面臨檢視。公司周一也暫緩推出能力更強的GPT-6.1 Astra模型，表示該模型有較高傾向向使用者誤述自身行動。Dots採用現有的GPT-6 Astra，而非遭暫緩的新版本。
OpenAI強調，使用者可設定Dots能存取的內容、執行範圍及何時須取得許可；更改密碼或永久刪除資料等敏感操作，必須獲得明確同意。Dots在獨立雲端電腦運作，公司也推出不留存企業資料的私密安全檢查工具，並重申預設不會使用企業客戶資料訓練模型。這些措施能否讓企業放心交付工作，將是Dots擴張的關鍵。
paras_en: OpenAI announced on Tuesday (the 29th) a continuously operating AI agent called "Dots" that can track targets across applications and proactively complete tasks, targeting the enterprise market and competing with Meta (META-US), which recently launched Muse. OpenAI also introduced a $500‑per‑month Pro plan that offers higher usage limits and faster processing speeds.

According to foreign media reports, CEO Sam Altman introduced Dots at the developer conference in San Francisco. The agent runs on the existing GPT‑6 Astra model, can operate cloud computers, read authorized application data, conduct research, write documents and develop software. Users can interact via ChatGPT messages or calls, and also assign tasks through Slack or Microsoft Teams.

Cross‑application continuous work to win enterprise customers
Dots can keep up with project changes, such as updating a sales pitch when client needs shift and then creating a demo version. It also leverages tools like Codex and ChatGPT Work. OpenAI is testing enterprise‑focused Dots for email marketing, accounting and legal analysis.

Starting Tuesday, Dots is being rolled out gradually to paying users, with each user initially able to run one agent and later manage multiple. OpenAI also unveiled ChatGPT Space for human‑AI collaboration and the lower‑priced GPT‑6.1 Sol model. The usage quota for the existing $200‑per‑month plan was reduced.

OpenAI said ChatGPT now has over 1.2 billion weekly active users, and Codex plus ChatGPT Work together exceed 35 million weekly users. As Meta’s Muse draws massive downloads, competition in AI agents is heating up; OpenAI also needs to grow revenue to fund its massive data‑center investments.

Regarding public listings, both OpenAI and Anthropic have secretly filed IPO paperwork. Reuters reported that OpenAI’s valuation could exceed $1 trillion, while Anthropic might reach $2 trillion. Bloomberg noted the timelines differ: Anthropic could IPO as early as this fall, whereas OpenAI said it is no longer expecting to list in 2026 as it focuses on safety concerns for its technology.

Safety concerns persist as the new agent emphasizes permission controls
Dots arrives amid scrutiny after OpenAI’s internal AI agents accessed Hugging Face and an Australian government health site without authorization during testing. The company also paused the rollout of the more powerful GPT‑6.1 Astra model, citing a higher tendency to misrepresent its actions to users. Dots uses the existing GPT‑6 Astra model, not the delayed version.

OpenAI emphasized that users can set what content Dots can access, its scope of operation, and when it must obtain permission; sensitive actions such as password changes or permanent data deletion require explicit consent. Dots runs on isolated cloud computers, and the company introduced a privacy‑focused security audit tool that does not retain enterprise data, reiterating that it will not use corporate customer data to train models. Whether these measures reassure businesses enough to entrust work to Dots will be crucial for its expansion.

items.title: 川普不想和中國一起管AI！直言恐拖累美企競爭力
items.title_en: Trump Doesn’t Want to Co‑Regulate AI with China, Says It Could Hurt U.S. Companies’ Competitiveness
paras: 美國總統川普周二(29日)表示，不願與中國國家主席習近平合作治理人工智慧(AI)，因為共同制定規範可能妨礙美國企業開發比中國更好的產品。他強調，美國目前在AI領域領先中國與其他國家，希望維持這項優勢。
綜合外媒報導，川普在華府一場活動表示，上周習近平訪美期間，兩人曾討論AI，美中政府也在許多領域合作，但他不認為應攜手治理AI。兩人對此的看法有所差異：川普主張維持現況，習近平則表示，發展與管理AI是雙方的責任，必須確保技術始終受人類控制、造福大眾。
川普預計周二稍晚在白宮與科技業高層討論AI。與會者預料包括Anthropic執行長阿莫戴、Meta(META-US)執行長祖克柏、Google(GOOGL-US)執行長皮查伊、輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳，以及OpenAI共同創辦人Greg Brockman等人；商務部長盧特尼克與眾議院議長強生也將出席。強生表示，會議將探討如何在創新與監督之間取得平衡。
這場會議正值AI安全疑慮升高。OpenAI與Anthropic近期通報，旗下AI代理程式曾在未獲指示的情況下侵入客戶系統，引發外界呼籲加強監管。阿莫戴上周在聯合國安理會警告，若管理不當，AI可能對全人類構成風險。川普則淡化AI威脅，認為過度管制會讓美國在與中國的競爭中落後。
《路透》與Ipsos於9月17日至20日進行的全國民調顯示，73%受訪者擔心AI公司未充分防範技術對社會造成嚴重傷害，55%認為放慢AI開發是好事。然而，美國參議院跨黨派AI監管立法目前陷入停滯，共和黨參議員克魯茲表示，希望11月期中選舉後再推進。
川普今年6月簽署的行政命令，提出前沿AI模型自願送審安排，開發商可在向可信賴合作夥伴發布模型前，提前最多30天提交政府審查。白宮尚未說明此次會議的具體議程。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday (the 29th) that he does not want to cooperate with Chinese President Xi Jinping on governing artificial intelligence (AI), because jointly setting rules could impede American firms from developing products that outperform China’s. He stressed that the United States is currently ahead of China and other countries in AI and wants to preserve that advantage.

According to a synthesis of foreign media reports, Trump told an event in Washington that during Xi’s visit to the United States last week the two discussed AI and that the U.S. and Chinese governments cooperate in many areas, but he does not believe they should work together to govern AI. Their views differ: Trump advocates maintaining the status quo, while Xi says the development and management of AI is a shared responsibility that must ensure the technology remains under human control and benefits the public.

Trump is expected to meet later on Tuesday at the White House with senior tech executives to discuss AI. Attendees are expected to include Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, Meta (META‑US) CEO Mark Zuckerberg, Google (GOOGL‑US) CEO Sundar Pichai, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang, and OpenAI co‑founder Greg Brockman, as well as Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo and House Speaker Kevin McCarthy. McCarthy said the meeting will explore how to strike a balance between innovation and oversight.

The meeting comes as concerns about AI safety are rising. OpenAI and Anthropic recently reported that their AI agents had infiltrated customer systems without authorization, prompting calls for tighter regulation. Amodei warned the United Nations Security Council last week that, if mismanaged, AI could pose a risk to all humanity. Trump downplayed the threat, arguing that over‑regulation would leave the United States lagging behind China in the competition.

A Reuters‑Ipsos national poll conducted from September 17‑20 showed that 73% of respondents worry AI companies are not doing enough to prevent serious societal harm, and 55% think slowing AI development is a good idea. However, bipartisan AI‑regulation legislation in the Senate is stalled, with Republican Senator Ted Cruz saying he prefers to push the issue forward after the November midterm elections.

The executive order Trump signed in June this year established a voluntary pre‑review process for frontier AI models, allowing developers to submit their models for government review up to 30 days before releasing them to trusted partners. The White House has not disclosed the specific agenda for the upcoming meeting.

items.title: 乖乖分散投資卻績效落後！債券跌出數十年難得買點？
items.title_en: Diversify, Yet Underperform! Are Bonds Offering a Rare Buying Opportunity After Decades?
paras: 今年以來，美股持續走高，債券卻受殖利率攀升拖累，讓遵循分散投資、定期再平衡的投資人反而吃虧。不過，隨著債券收益提高、股債估值差距擴大，這波賣壓也可能帶來數十年難得一見的債券布局機會。
《CNBC》市場分析指出，投資人不宜只因債券過去表現疲弱，就忽略目前更具吸引力的收益水準。另一方面，美股指數接近歷史高點，掩蓋了多數類股承壓的現實，也讓分散配置的必要性再度受到檢視。

股債配置今年失靈 債券收益吸引力卻升高

iShares核心美國綜合債券ETF(AGG-US)今年價格下跌4.8%，計入利息後總報酬仍為負2.2%，與標普500指數同期14%的總報酬形成鮮明對比，也拖累股債混合配置的績效。
上季底，標普500上漲15%、AGG大致持平，依紀律再平衡的投資人原本應賣出部分股票、增持債券。然而，本季標普500近3%的報酬，幾乎被債券進一步下跌抵銷，主因是基準公債殖利率持續逼近19年高點。
如今季底再平衡可能再度帶動資金轉向債券，但目前尚未見到明顯買盤。即使財富管理業者依既定計畫配置，帶動散戶資金流入固定收益基金，投資人對債券仍普遍抱持恐懼與厭惡。
分析指出，投資人常將股票下跌視為買點，卻可能因擔心殖利率從5%升至5.25%，而不願買進到期殖利率已達5%的五年期美國公債。但今日債市的起點已不同於十年前，不僅名目收益提高，扣除市場預期通膨後的實質殖利率，也接近20年高點。
美國銀行(BAC-US)證券股票與量化策略師Savita Subramanian表示，依盈餘殖利率與股息殖利率衡量，債券相對標普500的吸引力已達20多年來最高，也優於短天期定存收益。
她指出，估值不適合用來判斷短線進出時點，卻能提供長期報酬線索；其估值分析推算，標普500未來十年年化報酬可能為負3%。目前標普500股息殖利率不到1.4%，處於現代市場歷史低檔，高評級公司債則可提供約6%殖利率，違約風險相對較低。

指數撐在高檔 多數股票早已承壓

美股與公債過去十年的年化總報酬差距，已接近歷史極端水準，股票領先約15個百分點。這既反映大型科技股的驚人漲勢，也凸顯債券長期表現疲弱。
然而，當前美股強勢並不平均。標普500距高點僅約2%，那斯達克100更接近紀錄，但等權重標普500已回落6%、羅素2000下跌8%、KBW銀行指數修正12%，等權重非必需消費類股則下跌13%。
《CNBC》分析認為，油價、利率與鷹派Fed對景氣敏感類股造成壓力，反而可能促使資金流向被視為較能抵禦經濟波動的AI科技巨頭，支撐大型股指數。
標普500前十大科技股占指數市值約40%，這種高度集中目前保護了指數投資人的績效，卻也留下疑問：若美伊局勢與債市壓力緩解，弱勢類股能否大幅反彈，還是大型科技股會先補跌？

金融環境已收緊 Fed升息幅度仍有變數

指數下方的疲弱，也反映金融環境正在收緊。高盛(GS-US)分析顯示，若排除股票因素，金融情勢已接近2025年初關稅恐慌後的緊縮程度。
市場因此質疑，聯準會(Fed)是否還需要大幅升息。升息無法增加原油供給，也難以直接抑制AI資本支出，壓力卻可能集中落在消費者與小型企業身上。
KKR(KKR-US)全球財富首席投資策略師Lauren Goodwin表示，通膨來源與利率政策影響範圍不一致，是全球央行面臨的難題。因此，她更傾向將本輪政策變化視為因應較高中性利率的重新調整，而非大規模升息循環的開端。
這並不意味股六債四配置具有保證長期績效的魔法，也不能排除科技生產力提升持續推高股票報酬。不過，分析強調，再平衡與分散投資的理由，並非能精準預測殖利率高點，而是承認市場、經濟與政策走向仍充滿未知。
paras_en: Since the start of the year, U.S. equities have kept climbing while bonds have been dragged down by rising yields, causing investors who follow diversification and periodic rebalancing to lose ground. However, as bond yields improve and the valuation gap between stocks and bonds widens, this selling pressure could create a once‑in‑decades bond‑placement chance.

CNBC market analysis notes that investors should not ignore the now‑more‑attractive yield levels simply because bonds performed weakly in the past. At the same time, U.S. equity indices are near historic highs, masking the pressure on many sectors and prompting a fresh look at the need for diversified allocations.

Stock‑bond allocation has faltered this year while bond yield appeal has risen. The iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG‑US) is down 4.8% this year; after accounting for interest its total return is still –2.2%, a stark contrast to the S&P 500’s 14% total return over the same period, dragging down mixed stock‑bond portfolio performance.

At the end of last quarter the S&P 500 was up 15% while AGG was roughly flat, so disciplined rebalancers should have sold some equities and added bonds. Yet this quarter the S&P 500’s near‑3% gain was almost wiped out by further bond declines, mainly because benchmark Treasury yields are edging toward a 19‑year high.

A rebalancing at the end of this quarter could again shift money into bonds, but clear buying pressure has not yet materialized. Even if wealth‑management firms allocate according to plan and draw retail inflows into fixed‑income funds, investors generally remain fearful and averse to bonds.

Analysts point out that investors often treat stock drops as buying opportunities, yet may shy away from five‑year U.S. Treasuries that now yield 5% because they fear yields could climb from 5.00% to 5.25%. Today’s bond market start line is unlike that of ten years ago: nominal yields are higher and real yields—after stripping out expected inflation—are near a 20‑year peak.

Bank of America (BAC‑US) securities analyst and quantitative strategist Savita Subramanian says that measured by earnings yield and dividend yield, bonds’ attractiveness relative to the S&P 500 is at its highest in more than two decades and even beats short‑term deposit rates.

She adds that valuation is not suitable for timing short‑term entries and exits, but it can provide clues to long‑term returns; her valuation model projects a –3% annualized return for the S&P 500 over the next ten years. The index’s dividend yield is now under 1.4%, a historic low in modern markets, while high‑grade corporate bonds can offer about a 6% yield with relatively low default risk.

Indices are perched at lofty levels while most stocks are already under pressure. The ten‑year annualized total‑return gap between U.S. equities and Treasuries has narrowed to an extreme historical level, with stocks leading by roughly 15 percentage points. This reflects the spectacular rise of large‑cap tech stocks and underscores the long‑term weakness of bonds.

Nevertheless, today’s equity strength is uneven. The S&P 500 is only about 2% below its peak, the Nasdaq‑100 is even closer to record highs, but the equal‑weight S&P 500 has fallen 6%, the Russell 2000 is down 8%, the KBW Bank Index has slipped 12%, and equal‑weight consumer‑discretionary stocks are down 13%.

CNBC analysis argues that oil prices, interest rates and a hawkish Fed are pressuring cyclical stocks, which may instead steer capital toward AI‑focused tech giants viewed as more resilient to economic swings, thereby supporting large‑cap index performance.

The S&P 500’s top ten tech stocks account for about 40% of the index’s market value; this concentration currently shields index investors’ performance but raises questions: if geopolitical tensions and bond‑market pressures ease, will lagging sectors rebound strongly, or will the big tech names continue to lead the recovery?

The financial environment has tightened, and the Fed’s rate‑hiking path remains uncertain. Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) analysis shows that, stripping out equity factors, financial conditions are approaching the tightness seen after the early‑2025 tariff‑induced tightening episode.

Markets therefore question whether the Federal Reserve still needs to raise rates aggressively. Higher rates do not increase crude‑oil supply nor directly curb AI capital spending, and the pressure may instead fall on consumers and small businesses.

KKR (KKR‑US) global wealth chief investment strategist Lauren Goodwin says that the sources of inflation and the scope of rate policy are mismatched, posing a dilemma for central banks worldwide. Consequently, she views the current policy shift as a recalibration toward a more neutral rate rather than the start of a large‑scale tightening cycle.

This does not mean a six‑stock‑four‑bond allocation guarantees long‑term performance, nor does it rule out continued stock returns driven by tech productivity gains. However, analysts stress that the case for rebalancing and diversification is not about precisely timing yield peaks, but about acknowledging that markets, the economy and policy trajectories remain full of unknowns.

items.title: 美債30年期殖利率恐見6%！巴克萊點名AI投資熱潮
items.title_en: U.S. 30-Year Treasury Yield Could Reach 6% as Barclays Highlights AI Investment Boom
paras: 美國30年期公債殖利率持續攀升，但巴克萊認為，債市可能還沒充分反映AI投資帶動生產力長期提升的影響。在這種情境下，30年期公債殖利率可能進一步升至6%，來到2000年6月以來未見的水準。
外媒周二(29日)報導，巴克萊資本美國利率研究主管Anshul Pradhan指出，市場目前仍將偏高的中性利率視為景氣循環現象，預期聯準會(Fed)為抑制通膨而升息後，利率最終會再降下來。但若企業透過AI投資持續提高生產力，長期利率的落點可能比投資人想像得更高。
美國科技巨頭今年的AI基礎建設支出，預估將接近過去三年合計的投資額。Pradhan表示，若這波投資使生產力成長持續加快，Fed未必需要把政策利率降回目前遠期市場隱含的水準。投資人屆時須上修對長期利率的預期，推高長天期公債殖利率。若市場對長期利率的估計逐步向短期估計靠攏，30年期殖利率的合理水準可能升至6%。
美國30年期公債殖利率本周一度突破5.61%，為2002年以來首見，較3月2日低點上升1個百分點。不過，6%並非巴克萊唯一的推演。若企業資本支出熱潮降溫、經濟成長放緩，Fed維持高利率的理由減少，美債價格可望回升，其中中期公債受惠最大。
另一項風險則來自財政。若殖利率上升推高政府利息支出，使財政前景惡化，投資人可能要求更高報酬才願意持有美債。在這種情況下，即使沒有生產力持續加速成長，10年至30年期公債殖利率仍可能承受最大的上升壓力。
paras_en: U.S. 30-year Treasury yields have been climbing steadily, but Barclays believes the bond market may not yet fully reflect the long‑term productivity boost from AI‑driven investment. In this scenario, the 30‑year yield could climb further to 6%, a level not seen since June 2000.

Barclays Capital’s U.S. rates research head Anshul Pradhan told foreign media on Tuesday (the 29th) that the market still treats a relatively high neutral rate as a cyclical phenomenon, expecting the Fed’s rate hikes to curb inflation will eventually be followed by a decline in rates. However, if firms keep raising productivity through AI investment, the long‑run rate floor could be higher than investors anticipate.

Spending by U.S. tech giants on AI infrastructure this year is projected to approach the total investment of the past three years combined. Pradhan said that if this wave of spending accelerates productivity growth, the Fed may not need to bring the policy rate back down to the level implied by current forward markets. Investors would then have to revise upward their expectations for long‑term rates, pushing up long‑dated Treasury yields. As market estimates for long‑term rates converge toward short‑term forecasts, a reasonable level for the 30‑year yield could rise to 6%.

The 30‑year Treasury yield briefly broke above 5.61% this week—the first time since 2002—and is up a full percentage point from the March 2 low. Yet 6% is not Barclays’ only scenario. If the corporate‑capex boom cools and economic growth slows, the Fed’s justification for keeping rates high diminishes, allowing U.S. bond prices to recover, with intermediate‑term Treasuries benefiting the most.

Another risk comes from fiscal pressures. Higher yields would raise the government’s interest costs, worsening the fiscal outlook and prompting investors to demand higher compensation to hold Treasuries. In that case, even without sustained productivity acceleration, 10‑ to 30‑year Treasury yields could still face the greatest upward pressure.

items.title: 油價太貴、工作更難找？美國9月消費者信心摔至逾12年低點
items.title_en: Oil Prices Too High, Jobs Harder to Find? U.S. September Consumer Confidence Falls to Over 12-Year Low
paras: 美國9月消費者信心大幅下滑，降至2014年以來最低水準。油價與生活成本居高不下，加上民眾對就業前景轉趨保守，壓抑未來半年購買汽車、房屋及大型家電的意願。儘管消費支出與勞動市場目前仍具韌性，這份調查顯示，通膨與高利率正逐漸侵蝕家庭對經濟的信心。
美國經濟評議會(The Conference Board)周二(29日)公布，9月消費者信心指數較8月下滑6.7點至81.9，創2014年以來新低；8月數值也遭下修。結果低於《路透》訪調經濟學家預估的89.2，也不及《彭博》調查的所有預測值。

物價與油價壓力蔓延 購買計畫縮手

衡量民眾對當前經濟看法的現況指數下跌近8點，降至2021年以來最低；反映未來六個月展望的預期指數則跌至逾一年低點。消費者對當前企業經營狀況的評價，為2024年9月以來首度轉為負面，並預期未來半年企業與就業情況都會惡化。
經濟評議會首席經濟學家Dana Peterson表示，受訪者對經濟的書面回覆大多偏向悲觀，提及物價、商品與服務成本，以及油氣價格的頻率都升至新高。美伊戰爭推升能源價格，美國汽油價格已遠高於每加侖4美元，零售柴油價格接近歷史高點，冬季來臨前暖氣油價格也攀升。
物價壓力反映在家庭規畫上：打算購買汽車、房屋及多項大型家電的消費者占比縮小。9月受訪者對未來一年通膨的平均預期升至6.1%，中位數預期為5.1%；預期未來一年利率上升的比率增加5.2個百分點至68.4%，顯示民眾擔心借貸成本進一步提高。

就業信心轉弱 Fed面臨兩難

勞動市場同樣傳出警訊。認為工作機會充裕的消費者占比降至2021年以來最低，認為工作難找的占比則上升，兩者差距縮至逾五年半最小。政府同日公布的數據也顯示，8月職缺降至五個月低點。未來半年預期收入增加的占比降至今年初以來最低，預期收入減少的比率則升至逾一年高點。
信心下滑遍及不同年齡、收入層及地區，並跨越不同政治立場，但目前尚未明顯轉化為消費支出或就業的大幅萎縮。聯準會(Fed)本月升息後，多名官員主張利率應進一步提高。Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家指出，能源漲價雖增添通膨壓力，實質所得再度受壓也將拖累經濟成長，Fed對進一步升息應保持謹慎。這份調查於9月1日至23日進行。
paras_en: U.S. consumer confidence plunged in September, dropping to its lowest level since 2014. Persistently high oil prices and living costs, combined with a more cautious outlook on employment prospects, are dampening intentions to purchase cars, homes, and major appliances over the next six months. Although consumer spending and the labor market remain resilient for now, the survey shows that inflation and high interest rates are gradually eroding households’ confidence in the economy.

The Conference Board released its September consumer confidence index on Tuesday (the 29th), showing a 6.7‑point decline from August to 81.9, a new low not seen since 2014; the August figure was also revised downward. The result fell short of Reuters‑surveyed economists’ forecast of 89.2 and was below all Bloomberg poll predictions.

Price and oil‑price pressures are spreading, curbing purchase plans. The current‑conditions index, which gauges how people view the economy today, fell nearly eight points to its lowest since 2021, while the expectations index, reflecting outlook for the next six months, slipped to a more than one‑year low. Consumers rated the present state of business operations negative for the first time since September 2024 and expect both corporate and employment conditions to worsen over the next half‑year.

Conference Board chief economist Dana Peterson said respondents’ written comments were largely pessimistic, with mentions of prices, the cost of goods and services, and oil‑gas prices hitting record highs. The war in Ukraine has pushed energy prices up, U.S. gasoline now well above $4 per gallon, retail diesel near historic peaks, and heating‑oil prices climbing ahead of winter.

Price pressures are reflected in household plans: the share of consumers intending to buy a car, a home or multiple large appliances shrank. In September, respondents’ average inflation expectation for the next year rose to 6.1%, with a median of 5.1%; the share expecting interest rates to rise in the next year jumped 5.2 percentage points to 68.4%, indicating worries about higher borrowing costs.

Job‑related confidence weakened, putting the Fed in a dilemma. The labor market also sent warning signs. The proportion of consumers who think jobs are plentiful fell to its lowest since 2021, while those who think jobs are hard to find rose, narrowing the gap to the smallest in over five and a half years. Government data released the same day showed August job openings fell to a five‑month low. The share expecting their income to rise over the next six months dropped to its lowest since the start of the year, while the share expecting income to fall rose to a more‑than‑one‑year high.

The confidence decline spans age groups, income levels, regions and political affiliations, but has not yet translated into a sharp drop in consumer spending or employment. After the Fed’s rate hike this month, several officials argued rates should rise further. Pantheon Macroeconomics economists noted that while higher energy prices add inflation pressure, the renewed squeeze on real incomes will also drag on growth, and the Fed should be cautious about additional hikes. The survey was conducted from September 1 to 23.

items.title: 金管會揭上半年金檢四大缺失 房貸不當搭售壽險、人頭戶防詐漏洞成焦點
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Reveals Four Major Findings from First Half 2026 Financial Inspections, Highlighting Improper Mortgage Insurance Bundling and Front‑Person Account Fraud Gaps
paras: 為維持金融檢查作業透明度並輔導業者自律，金管會今(29)日依據「金融檢查指導原則」，正式公布 2026 年度上半年金融機構主要檢查缺失及改善做法。本次檢查涵蓋金融控股公司、本國銀行、外商銀行、信合社、電支機構、投信、票券、證券及產壽險等 10 個業別，主要缺失焦點集中於「防制詐騙與洗錢」、「消費者保護」、「內部管理」及「資訊安全」四大領域。其中，銀行辦理房貸業務時是否「不當搭售房貸壽險」及「人頭戶防範」等議題，也成為關注焦點。
金管會指出，在防制洗錢與打擊資恐方面，部分金融機構存在嚴重漏洞。有客戶由「籌備處」變更為正式公司後，銀行未落實開戶審查，導致未能發現該公司符合警政署公布的人頭公司特徵，開戶後不久即遭 165 聯防通報。
此外，部分業者受理警察機關通報警示的電子支付帳戶後，未依規定第一時間通報聯徵中心；也有法人客戶已觸發多次疑似洗錢交易警示、資金快進快出且與一般公司營運模式不符，銀行卻未深入瞭解交易真實性。金管會強調，金融機構應落實開戶審查與持續交易監控，建立嚴密防線。
在消費者保護領域，金檢發現有銀行辦理房屋貸款時，未充分告知客戶可自主選擇是否投保房貸壽險，導致客戶誤以為投保為核貸的「必要條件」，甚至有業務員以「爭取較低利率」勸誘客戶投保。
對於媒體關心房貸壽險搭售情形是否嚴重，金管會檢查局副局長郭文龍回應，金檢抽查時發現有客戶在貸款諮詢的電話錄音中對利率與搭售表達疑慮，顯示銀行員在說明時未讓客戶清楚了解「擁有自主選擇權」或造成客戶誤解。郭文龍重申，金管會早已多次宣導「不得以買房貸壽險作為貸款搭售條件」，業務局後續將根據金檢報告與違規事實，評估是否進行相關處分。
此外，消保缺失還包括：業者未有效建置「客戶與理專/業務員通訊地址相同」的比對監控機制；基金廣告未平衡揭露獲利與風險；以及向非專業投資人推介具損失吸收能力(TLAC)債券等情況。
在授信與內部管理方面，金檢發現有金融機構辦理住宅及企業建築放款時，將未經主管機關核定的購地或重劃案件，逕自排除在《銀行法》第 72 條之 2 限額控管之外。
郭文龍解釋，部分都更或獎勵投資條例案件雖可依法免列入 72 條之 2 限制，但部分金融機構未經詳細查證就直接排除，顯見作業不夠審慎，已要求業者確實依規檢視資金用途。另外，金檢也發現部分機構未落實董事等利害關係人的資料申報與建檔，導致授信或交易前無法準確比對。
資訊安全為金融業運營根本，但金檢顯示，部分金融機構的對外服務網站引用了不安全的第三方函式庫；作業系統主機未建立安全強化標準，且最高權限帳號由管理人員自行持有、未納入集中管理或定期清查。
此外，行動應用程式管理也出現基本資安檢測不完整、參數設定允許明文傳輸，甚至嵌入的廠商安控軟體(SDK)含有中高風險漏洞卻未修補即上架等問題。金管會要求業者全面檢討網頁與 APP 安全設計，落實漏洞修補與帳號權限控管。
paras_en: To maintain transparency of financial inspections and guide industry self‑regulation, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) today (the 29th) announced, based on the “Financial Inspection Guidance Principles,” the main inspection deficiencies and remedial actions for financial institutions in the first half of 2026. The review covered ten sectors – financial holding companies, domestic banks, foreign banks, credit cooperatives, electronic payment firms, investment trusts, bill‑issuing companies, securities firms, and life‑insurance providers – with key issues concentrated in four areas: anti‑fraud and anti‑money‑laundering, consumer protection, internal management, and information security. Among them, whether banks improperly bundled mortgage life insurance with home‑loan products and the handling of “front‑person” accounts became focal points.

The FSC noted serious gaps in anti‑money‑laundering and counter‑terror‑financing controls at some institutions. In one case, a client that transitioned from a “pre‑incorporation” stage to a formal company was allowed to open an account without proper due‑diligence, despite matching the police‑defined characteristics of a front‑person company; the account was flagged shortly after opening by the 165 Joint Prevention Hotline.

Furthermore, some firms failed to promptly report electronic‑payment accounts flagged by police alerts to the Credit Information Center as required, and corporate clients that triggered multiple suspicious‑transaction alerts – showing rapid inflows and outflows inconsistent with normal business operations – were not thoroughly investigated by the banks. The FSC stressed that institutions must enforce rigorous account opening checks and continuous transaction monitoring to build a strong defensive line.

In the consumer‑protection domain, inspections found that certain banks did not adequately inform borrowers that purchasing mortgage life insurance was optional, leading customers to mistakenly believe it was a prerequisite for loan approval. Some sales staff even urged clients to buy the insurance by promising lower interest rates.

Addressing media concerns about the severity of mortgage‑insurance bundling, FSC Inspection Bureau Deputy Director Guo Wen‑long said that spot checks revealed callers expressing doubts about interest rates and bundling during loan‑consultation calls, indicating that bank staff failed to clearly convey customers’ right to choose or caused misunderstandings. Guo reiterated that the FSC has repeatedly warned that “mortgage life insurance must not be used as a condition for loan approval,” and the Business Bureau will assess whether to impose penalties based on inspection reports and any violations.

Other consumer‑protection shortcomings include the lack of a monitoring mechanism to match customers’ contact addresses with those of their financial advisers or sales staff, fund advertisements that do not balance profit disclosures with risk disclosures, and the promotion of TLAC (Total Loss‑Absorbing Capacity) bonds to non‑professional investors.

Regarding credit granting and internal management, inspections discovered that some institutions excluded land‑purchase or rezoning projects not approved by regulators from the loan‑amount caps stipulated in Article 72‑2 of the Banking Act when issuing residential and commercial construction loans.

Guo explained that while certain urban‑renewal or incentive‑investment projects can be lawfully exempt from the Article 72‑2 limit, some banks excluded projects without thorough verification, showing insufficient diligence. The FSC has ordered firms to rigorously examine fund usage according to regulations. Additionally, the inspection found that some institutions failed to collect and file conflict‑of‑interest information for directors and related parties, hindering accurate verification before credit decisions or transactions.

Information security is fundamental to financial operations, yet the inspection showed that some institutions’ external service websites used insecure third‑party libraries; operating‑system servers lacked hardened security standards; and privileged accounts were held by individual administrators without centralized management or periodic audits.

Mobile‑app management also exhibited basic security testing gaps, allowing plaintext transmission settings, and embedded vendor SDKs contained medium‑to‑high‑risk vulnerabilities that were not patched before release. The FSC has ordered firms to comprehensively review web and app security designs, implement vulnerability remediation, and enforce strict account‑permission controls.

items.title: AI PCB資本合作升級！Amazon砸15.9億元入股金像電，79億元新廠CapEx同步啟動
items.title_en: AI PCB Capital Partnership Upgrade! Amazon Invests NT$1.589 Billion in Jinxiang Electronics, NT$7.9 Billion New Plant CapEx Launched Simultaneously
paras: 2026年09月29日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器需求持續帶動PCB供應鏈擴產，金像電(2368-TW)29日公告，Amazon將以策略投資人身分參與私募，認購185萬6,308股，每股856元，估算投資金額約15.89億元。金像電同日也核准79億元新廠土地、建廠及設備投資，預計自2026年第4季起陸續投入。
此次私募參考價格為每股1,070元，實際認購價856元，相當於參考價的80%；若與金像電29日收盤價1,120元相比，認購價低約23.6%。不過，本次私募對象限定為策略性投資人，相關股票原則上自交付日起三年內不得自由轉讓。
金像電目前已切入AWS Trainium伺服器供應鏈，Trainium 3預計於2026年第3季量產，法人預期AWS相關產品將自第3季開始放量，並帶動下半年出貨攀升。
在既有供應鏈合作基礎上，Amazon進一步透過私募成為策略投資人，使雙方關係從產品供應延伸至資本合作。市場後續將關注Amazon入股後，是否進一步帶動Trainium伺服器、高速網通及資料中心相關PCB訂單。
金像電同日核准的79億元投資中，土地預算約38億元，建廠及設備資本支出約41億元，資金來源規畫透過無擔保可轉換公司債支應。

paras_en: September 29, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Continuing demand for AI servers is driving expansion in the PCB supply chain. Jinxiang Electronics (2368‑TW) announced on the 29th that Amazon will participate in a private placement as a strategic investor, subscribing to 1,856,308 shares at NT$856 per share, an estimated investment of about NT$1.589 billion. On the same day, Jinxiang also approved a NT$7.9 billion investment for land, construction and equipment for a new plant, expected to be rolled out starting in Q4 2026.

The reference price for this private placement was NT$1,070 per share, but the actual subscription price was NT$856, roughly 80% of the reference price; compared with Jinxiang’s closing price of NT$1,120 on the 29th, the subscription price is about 23.6% lower. However, the private placement is limited to strategic investors, and the shares are generally restricted from free transfer for three years from the delivery date.

Jinxiang has already entered the AWS Trainium server supply chain, with Trainium 3 slated for mass production in Q3 2026. Analysts expect AWS‑related products to ramp up from Q3 onward, boosting shipments in the second half of the year.

Building on existing supply‑chain cooperation, Amazon’s private‑placement investment makes it a strategic shareholder, extending the relationship from product supply to capital partnership. The market will watch whether Amazon’s stake further drives orders for Trainium servers, high‑speed networking, and data‑center‑related PCBs.

Of the NT$7.9 billion approved investment, about NT$3.8 billion is allocated for land acquisition and roughly NT$4.1 billion for plant construction and equipment. The funding is planned to be sourced through unsecured convertible corporate bonds.

items.title: H1科學園區營收年增29.27%創同期新高 國科會：受惠AI、雲端需求爆發性成長
items.title_en: H1 Science Park Revenue Up 29.27% YoY, Hits Record High; Council Highlights Explosive Growth from AI and Cloud Demand
paras: 國科會於今(29)日宣布，今(2026)年上半年受惠全球AI應用持續深化及高效能運算(HPC)技術加速發展，催生AI晶片與雲端服務的爆發性需求，驅動半導體業迎來成長浪潮，科學園區上半年營收達3.54兆元、年增29.27%，再創歷史同期新高。其中竹科營收1.12兆元、年增36.03%表現最佳；中科0.65兆元、年增20.63%；南科1.77兆元、年增28.57%。
科學園區2026年上半年營業額3.54兆元，較同期成長29.27%，再創歷史新高，其中竹科1.12兆元，較2025年上半年成長36.03%；中科0.65兆元，成長20.63%；南科1.77兆元，成長28.57%。’
國科會指出，進一步分析各產業成長情形，園區共六大產業也全面成長，積體電路產業在高效能運算(HPC)與AI應用需求帶動下，營收年增29.57%；光電產業雖然面板出貨動能放緩，但憑藉光纖通訊模組訂單增加，及不斷電系統銷售持續成長，營收平穩成長6.3%；電腦及周邊產業受惠AI應用深化及雲端服務需求強勁，帶動伺服器及相關週邊設備出貨動能豐沛，推升整體營收大幅成長82.49%。
精密機械產業同樣搭上AI應用浪潮及全球半導體相關產業擴展熱絡，帶動精密設備、自動化系統及精密元組件需求，年增37.65%；生物技術產業因醫療器材及新藥行銷策略發酵，加上CDMO(委託開發暨製造服務)專案顯著挹注效益，使營收年增17.44%；通訊產業則受惠主流網路通訊設備規格轉換動能，帶動上游關鍵元件銷售成長，年增13.01%。
展望下半年，國科會指出，全球經濟雖仍受地緣政治風險與全球貿易關稅成本轉嫁的雙重考驗，但在AI應用浪潮持續推升及半導體先進製程的優勢下，園區廠商將透過強化供應鏈韌性、深化客戶夥伴關係，全面提升全球市場的戰略競爭力。
國科會強調，目前參酌科學園區上半年營運趨勢及各大研究機構預測2026年經濟成長率，預估2026全年營業額將可交出亮眼的成績單。
paras_en: The Council of Science and Technology announced today (the 29th) that the first half of 2026 benefited from the deepening of global AI applications and the accelerated development of high‑performance computing (HPC) technology, sparking explosive demand for AI chips and cloud services and driving a growth wave in the semiconductor industry. Science park revenue reached NT$3.54 trillion in the first half, up 29.27% year‑over‑year, setting a new historical high for the same period. Among the parks, Hsinchu Science Park posted NT$1.12 trillion, up 36.03% and the best performer; Central Taiwan Science Park recorded NT$0.65 trillion, up 20.63%; and Southern Taiwan Science Park generated NT$1.77 trillion, up 28.57%.

Science park revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$3.54 trillion, a 29.27% increase over the same period last year, again a historic high. Hsinchu contributed NT$1.12 trillion, up 36.03% from the first half of 2025; Central Taiwan added NT$0.65 trillion, up 20.63%; and Southern Taiwan posted NT$1.77 trillion, up 28.57%.

The Council noted that, when breaking down growth by sector, all six major industries in the park expanded. The integrated circuit sector, driven by HPC and AI demand, saw revenue rise 29.57% year‑over‑year. The optoelectronics sector, despite a slowdown in panel shipments, maintained steady growth of 6.3% thanks to increased fiber‑optic communication module orders and continued sales of uninterruptible power systems. The computer and peripherals sector benefited from deeper AI applications and strong cloud service demand, boosting server and related peripheral shipments and lifting overall revenue by a striking 82.49%.

The precision machinery sector also rode the AI wave and the global expansion of semiconductor‑related industries, driving demand for precision equipment, automation systems and precision components, resulting in a 37.65% revenue increase. The biotechnology sector saw a 17.44% rise as medical device and new‑drug marketing strategies matured and CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization) projects delivered significant benefits. The communications sector benefited from a shift in mainstream network equipment specifications, spurring growth in upstream key component sales and delivering a 13.01% increase.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, the Council said that although the global economy still faces the dual challenges of geopolitical risks and the pass‑through of worldwide trade‑tariff costs, the ongoing AI wave and the advantages of advanced semiconductor processes will enable park firms to strengthen supply‑chain resilience and deepen customer‑partner relationships, thereby enhancing their strategic competitiveness in global markets.

The Council emphasized that, based on the first‑half operating trends of the science parks and forecasts from major research institutions for 2026 economic growth, the full‑year 2026 revenue is expected to deliver an impressive performance.

items.title: 北市府率12家台企訪「新加坡科技周」 展AI整合實力拓展東南亞商機
items.title_en: Taipei City Government Leads 12 Taiwanese Companies to Singapore Tech Week, Showcasing AI Integration Strength to Expand Southeast Asian Opportunities
paras: 台北市產發局繼去(2025)年參展取得豐碩成果後，連續第2年再訪面向東南亞的高口碑展會「2026新加坡科技周」，於本(9)月29日、30日在外貿協會協助下，攜手12家北市科技產業設「台北主題館」，以「Smart Tech.Innovative Taipei」為主軸，對新加坡及東南亞市場展現對AI與智慧解決方案的需求，展現從產業從運算設備、資料治理到終端應用的軟硬整合實力，透過現場洽談及展後追蹤，協助企業拓展國際合作商機。
目前新加坡持續推動「智慧國家2.0」，帶動數位基礎設施、資安防護、企業數位轉型及AI應用需求。依新加坡官方統計，2025年台星商品貿易總額約1,700億星幣(約1,310億美元)，加上台灣為新加坡最大商品貿易夥伴，雙方產業優勢互補，也使新加坡成為台北企業鏈結東南亞市場的重要節點。
此次新加坡科技周整合雲端與AI基礎設施、DevOps、資安、大數據與AI及資料中心等五大專業展，匯聚眾多具影響力的企業技術決策者與具競爭力的解決方案業者。本次臺北主題館依技術鏈與應用需求，將12家企業整合為「智慧運算與感知」、「資料治理與安全」及「智慧應用與服務」三大展示面向，從基礎算力、數據管理延伸至商務服務與人才培訓，呈現台北AI產業的完整解決方案，讓國際買主可快速掌握合作方向。
在「智慧運算與感知」面向，輔信科技與展嘉科技以高算力邊緣運算設備支援即時運算需求；光影立方展出裸眼3D顯示技術；愛比科技與英晟電子整合智慧影音及傳輸系統；皓博科技則以AI設備感知與預測維護方案，協助企業掌握設備狀態及營運風險。
在「資料治理與安全」面向，核桃運算、精誠(6214-TW)資訊及叡揚資訊(6752-TW)分別展出數據平台、資安防禦及雲端碳管理方案；「智慧應用與服務」則由以力科技、優必達及阿特發科技帶來對話式商務平台、互動式虛擬人與XR培訓平台，展現AI技術在企業決策、商務服務及人才培訓等場域的應用潛力。

北市產發局表示，台北具備完整的資通訊研發能量與AI產業鏈，新加坡則是鏈結東南亞市場的重要門戶，雙方在智慧科技與數位轉型領域具高度合作潛力，繼2025年初次參加即促成約2,500萬美元的潛在商機，今年持續拓展耕耘新加坡及東南亞市場，本次參展除展現臺北企業及科技產品的軟硬整合優勢，亦透過強化買主邀約及展後追蹤，協助企業將展會接觸轉化為可持續推進的合作機會，深化與東南亞夥伴的合作關係，共同開拓數位轉型市場契機。
paras_en: The Taipei City Department of Economic Development, after achieving fruitful results at last year’s exhibition, returned for the second consecutive year to the highly regarded Southeast‑Asia‑focused event “2026 Singapore Tech Week.” With the help of the Taiwan External Trade Development Council, twelve Taipei‑based tech firms set up a “Taipei Theme Pavilion” on September 29‑30, centered on “Smart Tech. Innovative Taipei,” to demonstrate the demand for AI and smart solutions in Singapore and the broader Southeast Asian market. The pavilion highlighted end‑to‑end integration from computing hardware and data governance to terminal applications, using on‑site meetings and post‑event follow‑up to help companies expand international partnership opportunities.

Singapore is currently advancing its “Smart Nation 2.0” agenda, driving demand for digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, corporate digital transformation and AI applications. According to official Singapore statistics, total trade in Taiwanese‑Singaporean goods reached about S$170 billion (approximately US$131 billion) in 2025. With Taiwan being Singapore’s largest goods‑trade partner, the complementary strengths of the two economies make Singapore a key node for Taipei firms to connect with the Southeast Asian market.

The Singapore Tech Week this year combined five professional exhibition tracks—cloud and AI infrastructure, DevOps, cybersecurity, big data and AI, and data centers—drawing numerous influential corporate technology decision‑makers and competitive solution providers. The Taipei Theme Pavilion organized the twelve participating companies into three showcase categories—“Intelligent Computing and Sensing,” “Data Governance and Security,” and “Smart Applications and Services”—aligned with technology stacks and application needs. From foundational compute power and data management to business services and talent training, the pavilion presented a complete Taipei AI industry solution suite, enabling international buyers to quickly grasp collaboration opportunities.

In the “Intelligent Computing and Sensing” segment, Fuxin Technology and Zhanjia Technology showcased high‑performance edge‑computing devices for real‑time processing; LightCube displayed naked‑eye 3D display technology; iBii Technology and Yingcheng Electronics integrated smart audio‑visual and transmission systems; and Haobo Technology offered AI‑driven equipment sensing and predictive maintenance solutions to help enterprises monitor asset status and operational risks.

In the “Data Governance and Security” segment, Walnut Computing, Jingcheng Information (6214‑TW) and Ruiyang Information (6752‑TW) exhibited a data platform, cybersecurity defense, and cloud carbon‑management solutions respectively. The “Smart Applications and Services” segment featured Yili Technology, Youbida, and Artifex Technology presenting conversational business platforms, interactive virtual humans, and XR training platforms, demonstrating AI’s potential in corporate decision‑making, business services, and talent development.

The Taipei City Department of Economic Development noted that Taipei possesses a complete ICT R&D capability and AI industry chain, while Singapore serves as a crucial gateway to the Southeast Asian market. The two sides have strong cooperative potential in smart technology and digital transformation. After the 2025 debut generated roughly US$25 million in potential deals, this year’s participation continues to cultivate the Singapore and Southeast Asian markets. The exhibition not only showcased Taipei firms’ hardware‑software integration advantages but also strengthened buyer invitations and post‑event follow‑up, helping companies turn exhibition contacts into sustainable collaborations, deepening partnerships with Southeast Asian allies and jointly exploring digital‑transformation market opportunities.

items.title: 原料行情續揚惟下游需求仍偏弱 豐興鋼筋盤價止漲轉平
items.title_en: Raw Material Prices Keep Rising but Downstream Demand Remains Weak; Fengxing Rebar Plate Stops Rising and Turns Flat
paras: 鋼筋廠豐興(2015-TW)今(29)日開出本周盤價，雖然廢鋼報價續漲，但因需求仍偏弱，因此本周廢鋼收購價開出平盤，鋼筋也轉為平盤。
國際原料行情來看，美國大船廢鋼本週無報價，日本2H廢鋼本週上漲5美元至每公噸363美元，美國貨櫃廢鋼本週報價上漲4美元至每公噸348美元，澳洲鐵礦砂由每公噸98.2美元下跌至95.85美元。
豐興表示，上週調漲鋼筋後，市場反應溫和，主要因需求仍偏弱，客戶僅採購部分所需，但因]上游原料報價續漲，鋼筋價格易漲難跌，考量實際成交狀況下，故決議本週盤價以平盤開出。
盤價持平下，豐興廢鋼收購價每公噸9800元，鋼筋基每公噸1.83萬元，型鋼基價同樣維持每公噸2.5萬元。
paras_en: Rebar manufacturer Fengxing (2015‑TW) released this week’s price list today (the 29th). Although scrap‑steel prices continued to rise, demand remains weak, so the scrap‑steel purchase price was set flat for the week and rebar also turned flat.

Looking at international raw‑material markets, there was no quote for large U.S. bulk scrap steel this week; Japanese 2H scrap steel rose $5 to $363 per metric ton, U.S. container scrap steel rose $4 to $348 per metric ton, and Australian iron‑ore fines fell from $98.2 to $95.85 per metric ton.

Fengxing said that after raising rebar prices last week, market reaction was moderate, mainly because demand is still weak and customers only purchase part of their needs. However, with upstream raw‑material prices continuing to rise, rebar prices tend to go up rather than down. Considering the actual transaction situation, they decided to set this week’s price list flat.

With the price list flat, Fengxing’s scrap‑steel purchase price is NT$9,800 per metric ton, the base price for rebar is NT$18,300 per metric ton, and the base price for shaped steel remains at NT$25,000 per metric ton.

items.title: 外資節後繼續砍股 賣超632億元 大砍元大台50、00406A雙雙超過6萬張最多
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Keep Cutting Stocks After Holiday, Net Sell NT$63.2 bn; Massive Cuts in Yuanta Taiwan 50 and 00406A Both Exceed 60,000 Shares
paras: 台股今(29)日為連假後首交易日，指數在電子權值股走弱下開低震盪，終場下跌392.64點或0.82%，收47,631.96點跌破5日線及4萬8千點，成交量為7,850億元。外資單日共賣超632.01億元，大砍元大台灣50(0050-TW)、主動中信台灣收益(00406A-TW)分別為6.8及6.2萬張最多。
觀察三大法人單日籌碼動向，外資賣超632.01億，連二賣；自營商轉為賣超164.03億，投信則站在買方，共買超14.17億，三大法人合計賣超781.87億元。期貨部位，外資空單增加至7.9萬口，接近8萬口。
外資今日買超前10名中，以南亞買超3.02萬張最多，其次為友達1.55萬張、力積電1.52萬張、中鋼1萬張、臻鼎-KY 9,984張、大華韓國KOSPI50(009829-TW) 8,680張、台塑化8,411張、緯創8,080張、華邦電7,391張、鼎元7,054張。
外資今日賣超前10名為以元大台灣50最多共6.81萬張、主動型ETF中信台灣收益為6.21萬張、南茂2.06萬張、國巨*1.55萬張、主動統一台股增長(00981A-TW)1.54萬張、仁寶1.39萬張、聯電1.27萬張、京元電子1.26萬張、台新新光金1.16萬張、台中銀1.16萬張。也賣超台積電3,736張。
投信今日買超前10名以聯電9,537張最高、其次為台塑化8,088張、元大台灣50共2,250張、昇陽半導體2,202張、南亞1,825 張、元大金1,331張、晶技1,050張，長榮航、金像電。
投信今日賣超前10名為華邦電1,987最高、其次為富邦金1,687張、國巨*1,518張、日月光投控、南亞科、智邦、奇鈜、裕融、億光、致茂。
法人表示，指數從技術面來看，日K收黑且跌破5日線，短線轉為回測整理，加上收盤接近當日低點，顯示回升力道有限，但仍在10日線上，但不宜僅憑單日下跌判定中期轉空，建議短線先觀察今日低點能否守住，上檔則以48,000點為主要反壓，後續若回測時若量能收斂、低點不再下移，加上電子權值股止跌下，才有利於整理後再回測反攻。
paras_en: Taiwan's stock market today (the 29th) was the first trading day after the long weekend. The index opened lower and fluctuated amid weakness in heavyweight electronics stocks, ending down 392.64 points or 0.82% at 47,631.96, breaking below the 5‑day moving average and the 48,000‑point level. Trading volume was NT$7.85 trillion. Foreign investors sold a net NT$63.201 billion, with the biggest net sells in Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) and the active ETF China Trust Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW), each exceeding 60,000 shares (68,000 and 62,000 respectively).

Looking at the daily capital flows of the three major institutional groups, foreign investors sold a net NT$63.201 billion, marking a second consecutive day of net selling; proprietary traders switched to a net sell of NT$16.403 billion, while investment trusts remained buyers with a net purchase of NT$1.417 billion. Overall, the three groups sold a combined NT$78.187 billion. In the futures market, foreign investors increased their short positions to 79,000 contracts, close to 80,000.

Among the top ten stocks bought by foreign investors today, Nanya Technology led with a net buy of 30,200 shares, followed by AU Optronics (15,500 shares), Powerchip Technology (15,200 shares), China Steel (10,000 shares), Zhen Ding‑KY (9,984 shares), Da Hua Korea KOSPI50 (8,680 shares), Formosa Plastics Corp. (8,411 shares), Wistron (8,080 shares), Winbond Electronics (7,391 shares) and Ding Yuan (7,054 shares).

The top ten stocks sold by foreign investors were led by Yuanta Taiwan 50 with a net sell of 68,100 shares, followed by the active ETF China Trust Taiwan Yield with 62,100 shares, Nan Mao (20,600 shares), Yageo (15,500 shares), the active Unified Taiwan Stock Growth ETF (00981A‑TW) with 15,400 shares, Compal (13,900 shares), United Microelectronics Corp. (12,700 shares), Jing Yuan Electronics (12,600 shares), Taishin Shin Kong Financial (11,600 shares) and Taichung Bank (11,600 shares). They also sold 3,736 shares of TSMC.

Among investment trusts, the top ten net buys were led by United Microelectronics Corp. with 9,537 shares, followed by Formosa Plastics Corp. (8,088 shares), Yuanta Taiwan 50 (2,250 shares), Sunplus Technology (2,202 shares), Nanya Technology (1,825 shares), Yuanta Financial (1,331 shares), ChipMOS (1,050 shares), and then Evergreen Marine and Golden Eagle Electronics.

The top ten net sells by investment trusts were headed by Winbond Electronics with 1,987 shares, followed by Fubon Financial (1,687 shares), Yageo (1,518 shares), ASE Technology Holding, Nanya Technology, Advantech, Qisda, Yulon, Everlight, and Chih Mao.

Institutional analysts said that, from a technical perspective, the daily chart closed in the red and fell below the 5‑day moving average, indicating a short‑term pull‑back. With the close near the day's low, upward momentum appears limited, though the index remains above the 10‑day line. They cautioned against labeling a medium‑term bearish shift based on a single day’s decline. They recommend watching whether today’s low can hold; resistance is around the 48,000‑point mark. If a pull‑back occurs with shrinking volume and the low stabilizes while heavyweight electronics stocks stop falling, the market could consolidate and later resume a rally.

items.title: Fed升息還沒完！三把手估年底可能再一次 但強調不用急
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hikes Not Over Yet! Three Officials Say Another Increase May Come by Year‑End, but No Rush
paras: 聯準會(Fed)官員周二(29日)接連釋出進一步緊縮政策的訊號。Fed三把手、紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)表示，今年底前可能適合再升息一次，但本月調升利率後，目前並無急於行動的必要；Fed理事巴爾(Michael Barr)則重申，經濟成長穩健、通膨仍偏高，可能需要進一步升息。主管金融監理的副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)則聚焦人工智慧(AI)，提醒銀行強化資安防禦，因應新興威脅。
Fed本月全員一致通過升息1碼，將聯邦資金利率目標區間調高至3.75%至4%，為2023年以來首次升息。會後公布的利率預測中位數顯示，官員預期年底前還會再升息一次；聯邦資金期貨價格則反映，投資人預期10月升息，12月也可能再度調升。

威廉斯認為年底前可再升息 AI與能源推升通膨

威廉斯周二在紐約州水牛城一場活動的預備講稿中表示，若經濟走勢大致符合預測，今年稍晚再調高一次聯邦資金利率目標區間，可能有助於通膨更及時回到目標。不過他強調，9月的升息行動已讓Fed有時間蒐集更多資訊，進一步釐清經濟前景，因此沒有急於採取下一步行動的必要。
威廉斯指出，中東衝突與AI相關建設仍是推升通膨的主要因素，關稅則已不再對商品價格通膨帶來額外推力。其中，AI相關需求衝擊的通膨效應日益明顯，他也預期能源價格對通膨的影響將比先前估計更大、持續更久，但目前尚無證據顯示，這些衝擊已擴散為更廣泛且持久的物價壓力。
隨著經濟展現韌性、勞動市場保持穩健，威廉斯認為通膨風險已升高。他表示，貨幣政策雖然無法讓船隻通行，也無法重啟輸油管線與煉油廠，卻能降低供給衝擊擴散為持續性通膨的風險。
威廉斯預估，今年通膨率將達3.5%，2027年降至略高於2%，直到2028年才會回到Fed的2%目標。

巴爾重申可能進一步升息 尚未見通膨及時回落趨勢

巴爾同日在底特律一場活動的預備講稿中，重申可能需要進一步升息，以確保通膨及時回到目標。他表示，目前通膨距離2%仍有一段差距，尚未看到能及時回歸目標的明確趨勢。
巴爾指出，在他的基本情境中，Fed可能仍須進一步調整政策。他強調，央行希望支持可持續且穩健的經濟成長，以促進最大就業，而物價穩定是達成這項目標的關鍵。
對於經濟前景，巴爾形容目前成長步調穩健，並預期在低失業率支撐下，今年下半年成長將進一步加速。強勁的企業投資與具韌性的消費支出，也持續支持穩健的勞動市場。
巴爾的談話延續上周立場：在經濟保持強韌之際，壓低通膨仍是政策制定者更優先的考量。不過，他此次並未明確指出後續升息的次數或時點。

鮑曼關注銀行AI資安風險 籲強化防禦與權限管理

鮑曼則在科羅拉多州一場活動的預備講稿中，提醒銀行加強系統防護，以因應AI帶來的資安威脅，同時強調這項技術也能協助金融機構提升防禦能力。
她表示，AI對攻擊者與防禦者都具有龐大潛力，正成為資安措施的重要組成部分，既是防禦工具，也是持續演變的風險來源。
鮑曼指出，防範這些風險須從扎實的基本資安措施做起，包括維持最新的資訊資產清冊、採用可抵禦網路釣魚的多因素驗證、強化身分與存取權限控管，以及建立完善的漏洞辨識與修補管理機制。
她也強調，銀行董事會與高階管理層必須主動管理資安風險，但監理機關理解，因應這類威脅可能對社區銀行構成負擔與挑戰，因此Fed將持續依據銀行的風險概況及新興威脅，調整資訊科技檢查方式。
鮑曼先前曾表示，Fed不應對銀行運用AI等議題進行過度細節干預。《彭博》今年稍早報導，監理機關曾暫停部分資安相關檢查，讓銀行有時間強化系統，因應最新AI模型暴露的威脅。
paras_en: Federal Reserve officials on Tuesday (the 29th) released further signals of tightening policy. Fed’s third‑in‑command, New York Fed President John Williams, said another rate hike could be appropriate before the end of the year, but after this month’s increase there is no urgent need to act; Fed Governor Michael Barr reiterated that solid growth and still‑elevated inflation may require further hikes. Supervision chief Michelle Bowman focused on artificial intelligence, urging banks to strengthen cyber‑defenses against emerging threats.

The Fed unanimously voted this month to raise rates by one basis point, moving the federal funds target range to 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since 2023. The median of the post‑meeting rate forecasts shows officials expect another hike before year‑end; federal‑funds futures prices reflect investors’ view that a hike is likely in October and possibly again in December.

Williams said a later‑year hike could help bring inflation back to target if the economy follows current forecasts. He stressed that the September hike gives the Fed time to gather more data and clarify the outlook, so there is no need to rush the next step.

Williams noted that the Middle‑East conflict and AI‑related projects remain the main inflation drivers, while tariffs no longer add pressure to goods prices. He said AI‑driven demand is increasingly affecting inflation and that energy prices are likely to have a larger and longer‑lasting impact than previously thought, though there is no evidence yet that these shocks have turned into broad, persistent price pressures.

With the economy showing resilience and the labor market staying strong, Williams believes inflation risks have risen. He said monetary policy cannot move ships or restart pipelines and refineries, but it can reduce the risk that supply shocks evolve into sustained inflation.
Williams projected this year’s inflation rate at 3.5%, falling to just above 2% by 2027 and only returning to the Fed’s 2% goal in 2028.

Barr reiterated that further hikes may be needed to ensure inflation returns to target in a timely manner. He said inflation is still a distance from 2% and there is no clear trend showing it will revert quickly.

Barr explained that in his baseline scenario the Fed may still have to adjust policy further. He emphasized that the central bank wants to support sustainable, solid growth and maximum employment, with price stability being key to that goal.

Regarding the outlook, Barr described growth as steady and expects it to accelerate in the second half of the year, supported by low unemployment. Strong corporate investment and resilient consumer spending continue to underpin a robust labor market.
Barr’s remarks echo last week’s stance: with a strong economy, lowering inflation remains the policymakers’ top priority. He did not specify how many more hikes or when they might occur.
Bowman, focusing on banks’ AI‑related cyber risks, urged stronger defenses and access‑management measures, noting the technology can also help institutions improve security.
She said AI offers huge potential for both attackers and defenders, becoming a core component of cyber‑security—both a defensive tool and a continuously evolving risk source.

Bowman outlined that mitigating these risks starts with solid basic cyber hygiene: maintaining an up‑to‑date inventory of information assets, using multi‑factor authentication resistant to phishing, tightening identity and access controls, and establishing robust vulnerability detection and patch‑management processes.

She also stressed that bank boards and senior management must proactively manage cyber risk, but regulators understand that responding to such threats can burden community banks; therefore the Fed will keep tailoring its IT examinations based on each bank’s risk profile and emerging threats.

Bowman previously said the Fed should not micromanage banks’ use of AI. Bloomberg reported earlier this year that regulators paused some cyber‑related examinations to give banks time to shore up systems against threats revealed by new AI models.

items.title: 大摩首席美股策略師：美股若回檔10%　將引爆年底最強狂飆走勢
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Chief US Equity Strategist: A 10% Pullback in US Stocks Could Ignite the Strongest Year‑End Rally
paras: 摩根士丹利(下稱大摩)首席美國股票策略師Mike Wilson最新表示，在美債殖利率持續攀升、市場波動率升高之際，標普500指數若出現5%至10%的幅度適中的回檔，反而可能為年底行情進一步走強創造條件。
身兼投資長的他在大摩播客《Thoughts on the Market》中直言，「坦白說，我會歡迎這種調整」，並稱指數層面的調整往往是持續數月的市場內部調整過程結束的方式之一。若債市壓力無法緩解，美股恐面臨更大波動，但這未必意味著長期趨勢逆轉，而是完成內部調整後的重新啟動。
近期美債市場劇烈調整，30年期殖利率升至22年來高點，10年期達2007年以來最高。Wilson指出，2年期美債殖利率一度升至4.941%，已明顯高於Fed官員對2026至2028年3.9%至4.1%的預測路徑，顯示市場短期恐計入了過於鷹派的利率預期。
不過，他並未認為殖利率上升一定會破壞股市，而是關注波動是否擴散至股市及融資壓力是否影響企業行為。
目前市場內部分化明顯。Wilson指出，先前領漲的汽車、半導體和工業股近期表現疲軟，資金偏好正從追逐高成長主題轉向獲利品質、現金流和經營效率。面對高利率環境，他仍傾向於大型、高品質企業，尤其是具有穩定商業模式和基於費用收入模式的公司，市場正降低對單純成長故事的依賴。
根據Wilson判斷，若債券壓力緩解，市場廣度可追趕並推動大盤走高；若未緩解，指數或需進一步調整。這與摩根大通交易台近期觀點呼應，後者在殖利率趨穩、經濟數據韌性下重新轉向看多。當前AI投資熱潮雖支撐科技板塊，但不斷攀升的債券殖利率正提高市場對獲利兌現能力的要求，美股高估值環境面臨重新平衡。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley (referred to as "Morgan") chief US equity strategist Mike Wilson said that amid rising US Treasury yields and higher market volatility, a moderate 5%‑10% pullback in the S&P 500 could actually set the stage for further strength later in the year.

Wearing the CIO hat, he told Morgan’s podcast “Thoughts on the Market,” “Frankly, I would welcome this kind of adjustment,” adding that index‑level corrections are often one way the market’s multi‑month internal rebalancing concludes. If bond‑market pressure does not ease, US equities could face even greater volatility, but that does not necessarily signal a reversal of the long‑term trend – rather a restart after an internal correction.

The US bond market has recently undergone a sharp correction, with the 30‑year yield climbing to its highest level in 22 years and the 10‑year hitting its peak since 2007. Wilson noted that the 2‑year Treasury yield briefly rose to 4.941%, well above the Fed officials’ projected path of 3.9%‑4.1% for 2026‑2028, indicating that the market may have priced in overly hawkish rate expectations in the short term.
However, he does not believe that rising yields will automatically damage equities; his focus is on whether volatility spreads to stocks and whether financing pressures affect corporate behavior.

Market segmentation is now pronounced. Wilson said that previously leading auto, semiconductor and industrial stocks have recently lagged, with capital shifting from high‑growth themes toward profitability, cash flow and operational efficiency. In a high‑rate environment he still favors large, high‑quality companies—especially those with stable business models and fee‑based revenue streams—as the market reduces its reliance on pure growth stories.

According to Wilson, if bond pressure eases, market breadth can catch up and push the index higher; if not, the index may need further adjustment. This view aligns with recent commentary from JPMorgan’s trading desk, which, seeing yields stabilise and economic data remain resilient, has turned bullish again. While the AI investment frenzy continues to support the tech sector, climbing bond yields are raising the market’s demand for profit‑realisation, prompting a rebalancing of the US equity’s lofty valuation environment.

items.title: AI同事全天候待命！OpenAI推Dots 正面迎戰Meta Muse
items.title_en: AI Colleague On Call 24/7! OpenAI Launches Dots to Directly Challenge Meta's Muse
paras: OpenAI周二(29日)發表可持續運作的AI代理「Dots」，能跨應用程式追蹤目標、主動完成工作，搶攻企業市場，與近期推出Muse的Meta(META-US)競爭。OpenAI同時推出每月500美元的Pro方案，提供更高使用額度與更快處理速度。
綜合外媒報導，執行長阿特曼在舊金山開發者大會介紹Dots。這款代理使用現有GPT-6 Astra模型，可操作雲端電腦、讀取獲授權的應用程式資訊，研究資料、撰寫文件及開發軟體。使用者可透過ChatGPT傳訊或通話，也能從Slack、Microsoft Teams交辦任務。

跨應用程式持續工作 搶攻企業客戶

Dots可隨專案變化持續跟進，例如客戶需求改變時更新銷售提案，再製作展示版本。它也能運用Codex與ChatGPT Work等工具。OpenAI正測試電子郵件行銷、會計及法律分析等企業專用Dots。
Dots周二起逐步提供付費用戶使用，初期每人可使用一個代理，未來可管理多個。OpenAI另發表團隊與AI共同工作的ChatGPT Space，以及價格較低的GPT-6.1 Sol模型。既有每月200美元方案的部分使用額度則遭下調。
OpenAI表示，ChatGPT每周活躍用戶已超過12億，Codex與ChatGPT Work合計每周用戶逾3,500萬。隨著Meta的Muse吸引大量下載，AI代理競爭升溫；OpenAI也須擴大收入，以支應龐大的資料中心投資。

上市布局方面，OpenAI與Anthropic均已秘密提交上市申請文件。《路透》報導，OpenAI上市估值可能超過1兆美元，Anthropic則可能達2兆美元。不過，《彭博》指出，兩家公司時程不同，Anthropic最快可能於今年秋季首次公開募股(IPO)，OpenAI則表示，為專注處理旗下技術的安全疑慮，已不再預期於2026年上市。

安全爭議未歇 新代理強調權限控管

Dots問世之際，OpenAI因旗下AI代理在內部測試時，未獲指示便侵入Hugging Face及澳洲政府衛生網站而面臨檢視。公司周一也暫緩推出能力更強的GPT-6.1 Astra模型，表示該模型有較高傾向向使用者誤述自身行動。Dots採用現有的GPT-6 Astra，而非遭暫緩的新版本。
OpenAI強調，使用者可設定Dots能存取的內容、執行範圍及何時須取得許可；更改密碼或永久刪除資料等敏感操作，必須獲得明確同意。Dots在獨立雲端電腦運作，公司也推出不留存企業資料的私密安全檢查工具，並重申預設不會使用企業客戶資料訓練模型。這些措施能否讓企業放心交付工作，將是Dots擴張的關鍵。
paras_en: OpenAI announced on Tuesday (the 29th) a continuously operating AI agent called "Dots" that can track targets across applications and proactively complete tasks, targeting the enterprise market and competing with Meta (META-US), which recently launched Muse. OpenAI also introduced a $500‑per‑month Pro plan that offers higher usage limits and faster processing speeds.

According to foreign media reports, CEO Sam Altman introduced Dots at the developer conference in San Francisco. The agent runs on the existing GPT‑6 Astra model, can operate cloud computers, read authorized application data, conduct research, write documents and develop software. Users can interact via ChatGPT messages or calls, and also assign tasks through Slack or Microsoft Teams.

Cross‑application continuous work to win enterprise customers
Dots can keep up with project changes, such as updating a sales pitch when client needs shift and then creating a demo version. It also leverages tools like Codex and ChatGPT Work. OpenAI is testing enterprise‑focused Dots for email marketing, accounting and legal analysis.

Starting Tuesday, Dots is being rolled out gradually to paying users, with each user initially able to run one agent and later manage multiple. OpenAI also unveiled ChatGPT Space for human‑AI collaboration and the lower‑priced GPT‑6.1 Sol model. The usage quota for the existing $200‑per‑month plan was reduced.

OpenAI said ChatGPT now has over 1.2 billion weekly active users, and Codex plus ChatGPT Work together exceed 35 million weekly users. As Meta’s Muse draws massive downloads, competition in AI agents is heating up; OpenAI also needs to grow revenue to fund its massive data‑center investments.
